```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
set.seed(87532)
```
RNAseq transcript tpm data using RSEM. Log2 transformed, using a pseudo-count of 1. - Rows: Omics Profile IDs - Columns: transcripts (HGNC symbol and ensembl transcript ID)
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
# read in transcript expression data for the coding genes
coding_rna<- read_csv(file="../input/coding_rna.csv")

# read in latest version of the selected genes

final_gene_list <- read_csv(file = "../output/final_gene_list_2025-05-07.csv")

selected_genes_transcripts<- coding_rna %>% filter(Gene %in% final_gene_list$Gene) %>% droplevels()

length(unique(selected_genes_transcripts$Gene))
setdiff(final_gene_list$Gene, coding_rna$Gene)
# three genes are missing because of annotation issue, added them manually

selected_genes_transcripts<- rbind(selected_genes_transcripts, (coding_rna %>% filter(Gene %in% c("H3-3A",  "KRTAP5-7" ,"KRTAP4-2")) %>% droplevels()))
print(paste("we have transcripts for all",length(unique(selected_genes_transcripts$Gene)),"/" , length(unique(final_gene_list$Gene)), "genes."))

```

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("biomaRt", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
  BiocManager::install("biomaRt")
}
library(biomaRt)

 
selected_genes_transcripts <- selected_genes_transcripts %>% mutate(Transcript_ID = str_replace_all(Transcript_ID, "\\(|\\)", ""))


ensembl=useEnsembl(biomart="genes",dataset="hsapiens_gene_ensembl", version=110)   # dataset and database chosen.


transcript_data = getBM(attributes = c('external_gene_name','ensembl_transcript_id','transcript_length','ensembl_gene_id',"transcript_biotype" ),filters = 'ensembl_transcript_id', values = selected_genes_transcripts$Transcript_ID, mart = ensembl)
transcript_data<- transcript_data %>% rename(Transcript_ID=ensembl_transcript_id)
names(transcript_data)
selected_genes_transcripts<-left_join(selected_genes_transcripts, transcript_data,by="Transcript_ID")

summary(as.factor(selected_genes_transcripts$transcript_biotype))

#select only protein coding transcripts
selected_genes_transcripts<- selected_genes_transcripts %>% filter(transcript_biotype=="protein_coding")

#select highest expression transcript per cell line

melted_tr_data<- reshape2::melt(selected_genes_transcripts,id.vars=c("Gene", "Transcript_ID", "external_gene_name", "ensembl_gene_id", "transcript_biotype","transcript_length"  ))
levels(melted_tr_data$variable)
max_exp<- melted_tr_data %>% group_by(Gene, variable) %>% summarise(max=max(value))

melted_tr_data<- left_join(melted_tr_data, max_exp, by=c("Gene", "variable"))
melted_tr_data<- melted_tr_data %>% mutate(gene_max_tr="none") %>% mutate(gene_max_tr=case_when(
  value < 1 ~"low",
  value==max ~ "max",
  TRUE~"none"
))  

melted_tr_data<- melted_tr_data %>% filter(gene_max_tr=="max") %>% droplevels()

#check how many genes have zero expression in selected cell lines
unique_tr <- melted_tr_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Transcript_ID) %>%
  unique()

unique_genes<- as.data.frame(table(melted_tr_data$Gene))

print(paste0("there are ", nrow(unique_tr)," unique protein coding transcripts for ", nrow(unique_genes), " genes with an expression at least one of the selected cell lines")) 



# select a random transcript for low expression genes

set.seed(87532)
p<-selected_genes_transcripts %>% filter(Gene %in% setdiff(selected_genes_transcripts$Gene, melted_tr_data$Gene)) %>% group_by(Gene) %>% slice_sample(n=1)

# combine all selected transcripts
final_transcript_list<- rbind(unique_tr, (p %>% dplyr::select(Gene, Transcript_ID)))
#check for duplications
sum(duplicated(final_transcript_list$Transcript_ID))
view(unique_tr)
```


```{r}
# get data for selected transcripts

final_selected_transcript_data<- selected_genes_transcripts %>% filter(Transcript_ID %in% final_transcript_list$Transcript_ID) %>% droplevels()
length(unique(final_selected_transcript_data$Gene))


# count how many transcripts per each gene

trancript_count<- as.data.frame(table(final_selected_transcript_data$Gene))
names(trancript_count)<- c("Gene", "count")
final_selected_transcript_data<- left_join(final_selected_transcript_data, trancript_count, by="Gene")

write_csv(final_selected_transcript_data, file=paste0("~/sym_101_design/output/final_selected_transcript_data_", Sys.Date(),".csv"))


```

protein_coding<- syp_101_final_selected_gRNAs_with_control %>% filter(transcript_biotype=="protein_coding")
setdiff(protein_coding$Transcript_ID, final_selected_transcript_data$Transcript_ID)
